findings.detail: The September 30, 2025 review population appears to include the separate December 31, 2024 SOI block, producing 236 leaves while only the 118 current-period leaves should be in scope.

rationale: B01 failed because only 118 of 236 extracted leaves have fair value. Raw source shows a current September 30 schedule total of fair value 1,364,884,229 and a separate comparative December 31 schedule total of fair value 1,029,942,922. The exact 50% completeness pattern is therefore not an absence of source fair values; it is a current-period population defect caused by comparative-period SOI rows leaking into the September 30 holding leaves.
